hero_subtitle: Compile standard annotated Python into ultra-fast, zero-dependency native executables. No CPython runtime to bundle, zero container bloat, instant startup.
metric_1_desc: Geometric mean speedup across compute kernels vs standard CPython.
metric_2_desc: Radically reduced RSS footprint. Pack more tasks onto leaner instances.
metric_3_desc: Instant sub-millisecond execution for CLI tools, lambdas & serverless.
metric_4_desc: Single self-contained file. Zero dependencies, zero virtualenvs to ship.
parity_title: Write standard Python. Keep byte-for-byte parity.
parity_subtitle: No new language to learn and no rewrite in Rust or C++. pyscriptc turns standard typed Python into high-performance native machine code with zero guessing.
parity_guarantee_desc: Unlike JIT engines that deoptimize unpredictably when types fluctuate at runtime, pyscriptc statically resolves your types at compile time. What compiles runs with steady, guaranteed native latency.
parity_sem_desc: Arbitrary precision integers, IEEE-754 floats, and standard exception handling preserved.
parity_diag_desc: Actionable diagnostic codes highlight untyped constructs before shipping to production.
surfaces_subtitle: Produce the exact executable format needed across your application architecture.
surface_1_desc: Single-file executable with zero runtime dependencies. Sub-millisecond cold start, 24x faster execution, and 6x lighter memory footprint for microservices and CLI tools.
surface_2_desc: Export standard C ABI functions with header files (.h). Embed high-speed compiled Python routines seamlessly into Rust, Go, Swift, C++, or Node.js.
surface_3_desc: Compile typed Python directly to lightweight WebAssembly (wasm32-wasi). Run secure sandboxed Python in browsers and edge workers with tiny payloads.
cross_subtitle: Target any cloud, server, or edge architecture with a single flag. No multi-gigabyte Docker build containers, no complex cross-toolchain setup headaches.
cta_title: Ready to ship Python as native code?
cta_subtitle: Start compiling typed Python into standalone executables in under two minutes.
footer_tagline: Compile standard typed Python to standalone native binaries. Zero CPython at runtime.
